play: Discovery: each player holds the TOP SECRET stamp to open their case file, then passes the phone on.
Night: everyone closes their eyes. The Mafia opens theirs and silently agrees on a target.
Then the phone goes around the table: everyone takes a secret turn, even with no power, so nobody can tell who's who.
Morning: find out who didn't make it through the night.
Day: talk it over, then point at who you think is Mafia. The city arrests one player.
The city wins when the whole Mafia family is arrested; the Mafia wins when it equals the rest of the city.

nightFall: The city goes quiet. Streetlights flicker… Everyone, close your eyes.
Rain on the windows, sirens far away… Close your eyes, everyone.
The last tram rolls by and the city sleeps. Eyes closed, everyone.
wolvesWake: Mafia, open your eyes. Find your family and choose your target silently. Ten seconds.
Family, wake up. Look around, and pick your target without a sound.
wolvesTwice: Mafia, open your eyes. Tonight the family strikes twice. Choose two targets.
The family wants revenge tonight. Mafia, wake up and choose two targets.

Family, back to sleep… City, open your eyes. Pass the phone along.
passStart: Pass the phone around. Everyone takes a turn, so nobody can tell who did what.
One by one, take the phone. Keep a straight face, then pass it on.
voteCountdown: On my count: three, two, one… Point!
